ActingState.description: One span of a character's emotional trajectory. `carry: true` inherits the previous state's values.
ActingState.title: ActingState

AddedElement.description: A scene-local element (key prefixed `el_x_`); it never enters World DNA.
AddedElement.title: AddedElement

pause_ms.description: explicit pause length; otherwise from the tag
pause_ms.title: Pause Ms

AssetRef.description: A user asset used by the spec (B-roll, screen recordings, logos, reference frames).
AssetRef.title: AssetRef

BehaviorEvent.description: A discrete behavior at a word (`at`) or over a span. The type's vocabulary entry gives its dimension.

target.description: a world element key or attention target
target.title: Target

BehaviorEvent.title: BehaviorEvent

CreativeBrief.description: Director stage 1 output (§13). `raw_input` is the user's text, stored byte for byte.
CreativeBrief.title: CreativeBrief

DerivedFrom.description: Why a decision was made (§11 traceability). `compiler_approximation` entries carry the planned route's digest.
DerivedFrom.title: DerivedFrom

DurationSpan.description: A span of fixed length after a shot point or a segment edge (title cards, silent holds).
DurationSpan.title: DurationSpan

Effect.description: A deterministic effect plugin applied over a span (`fx_` key; transitions, titles, lower thirds…).
Effect.title: Effect

ElementSource.description: Who wrote a state, event, annotation or derived element (§15.3).
ElementSource.title: ElementSource

EmotionSpec.description: `masking: true` = felt differs from displayed ("pretending to stay calm while surprised").
EmotionSpec.title: EmotionSpec

Generation.description: `seed_namespace` is the original video_id (copied on duplicate); seeds never derive from version ids.
Generation.title: Generation

LightingOverride.description: Lighting deltas. They must stay within the world tolerance unless `deviation_declared` (previz flags it).
LightingOverride.title: LightingOverride

MemoryPins.description: One MemorySnapshot per cast member (I7). Derived versions inherit them unless `refresh_memory` is applied.
MemoryPins.title: MemoryPins

preset_id.description: a render preset id from config/platforms
preset_id.title: Preset Id

target_wpm_delta.description: relative change of the WPM target
target_wpm_delta.title: Target Wpm Delta

QuoteSource.description: A real customer quote: needs consent (§32).
QuoteSource.title: QuoteSource

ResearchDossier.description: Director stage 3 output; source text is data, never instructions (I10).
ResearchDossier.title: ResearchDossier

ShotContinuityRef.description: Match a previous video's look. Enters cache keys as the referenced artifact's hash, never as ids (§12.2).
ShotContinuityRef.title: ShotContinuityRef

ShotType.description: Closed shot types (§11). `two_shot` is rejected while `multi_character_enabled=false`.
ShotType.title: ShotType

ref.description: element key, asset id, quoted statement or memory item id
ref.title: Ref

VoiceProsody.description: A per-video offset on the voice version's default prosody (§10.6).
VoiceProsody.title: VoiceProsody

WordRef.description: One word of a segment (index into the canonical tokenizer's output).
WordRef.title: WordRef

WordSpan.description: An inclusive word range. It may cross segments of the same scene, in order.
WordSpan.title: WordSpan

rect.description: x, y, width, height of the zoom window (0..1)
rect.title: Rect
